rows.grounds: optative verb expressing prescribed ritual action
dual instrumental naming the substances used in the offering
instrumental naming the mantra accompanying the offering

items.question: With what substances and mantra must the practitioner make the ritual offering?
premises: The practitioner is the agent of the prescribed action.
The offering is to be made with wine and flesh.
The offering is to be accompanied by the root mantra.
items.inference: Therefore, the practitioner should perform the offering using wine and flesh together with the root mantra.
uncertainties: The exact second member of the compound madyapalābhyāṃ (palāla or palā/māṃsa-related term) is interpreted here as flesh based on context and legacy hint.
items.plain_english: The practitioner should make the offering with wine and flesh, using the root mantra.
